text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED  Canary alert: rollout 'redwood-eagle-16b-q3' v5.1 showing increased 5xx rate and request duplication in us-east1. Window 10m: 5xx +9%, dup_request metric +18%. Dashboard: https://console.internal/r/rollouts/eagle-16b-q3

nora (oncall): ack. Oncall taking. adding @dan, @anya, @kevin, @lily. Starting mitigation checklist and collecting traces.

dan (eng-runtime): can you confirm if duplication is at the router layer or app layer? I see spikes in request-id counts in the request-proxy logs. Pulling proxy logs now.

monitor-bot: probe snapshot: /v1/generate latency p95 +350ms; dup_request rate across pods: [pod-a: 22%, pod-b: 5%].

anya (ml): quick theory: v5.1 introduced new attention-fusion kernel plus a batcher change that retries timed-out in-flight requests differently. Could lead to duplicates under transient backpressure. Also noticed slight memory delta in model memmap.

kevin (eng-sre): immediate mitigations: 1) flip router retry policy to 0 for canary cohort, 2) divert canary traffic to v5.0, 3) scale canary worker pool temporarily. I prefer flipping retry policy first (lowest blast radius).

lily (customer-success): two customers reported degraded output and duplicate completions in chat UI (org 1122 and 3344). CS posted triage messages and asked for ETA.

nora (oncall): executing router retry toggle for canary cohort now. command:
```bash
deploy-bot config set --service request-proxy --env hosted --key retry_attempts --value 0 --scope canary --author nora
```

deploy-bot: config change accepted. request-proxy config updated (tx 0xabcde).

dan (eng-runtime): seeing drop in dup_request on pod-a within 40s. proxy logs show fewer repeated request ids. sharing snippet from proxy:
```
2026-03-16T10:12:05Z proxy[pod-a] INFO req=0x59a dup_check: request-id 0x7f3 processed, retry_suppressed
2026-03-16T10:12:06Z runtime[pod-eagle-2] WARN handler: slow response for session=sess-92 latency=420ms
```

anya (ml): still seeing occasional 5xxs with tracebacks pointing to allocator exhaustion inside the fused-attn kernel when sequence >4096. sending a trimmed eval trace and heap snapshot.

kevin (eng-sre): can you attach heapdump link? I'll run a quick memory-usage correlation.

anya (ml): heap link: https://artifacts.internal/heap/eagle-5.1-heap-2812349999.tgz. trace id tri-009.

lily (customer-success): CS update: affected customers want either a rollback or SLA credit. flagged as high priority.

nora (oncall): we have three action tracks: quick config mitigation (done), deeper runtime patch (disable fused-attn opt), and rollback to v5.0. Decision: try runtime patch with progressive canary patch, rollback if errors >5% for 15m or Dedicated customer sees errors.

dan (eng-runtime): patch plan: runtime flag `--fused-attn=off` can be applied patchwise to canary pods, no model rebuild needed. restart per pod required, sequential drain recommended. Will kick off patch job.

deploy-bot: patch job queued: jid-9921 for model redwood-eagle-16b-q3 v5.1 scope canary strategy sequential.

(6m)

anya (ml): hypothesis log for RCA thread:
- H1: fused-attn kernel interaction with long-sequence >4k leads to transient allocator spikes and 5xxs.
- H2: router retry semantics in v5.1 cause duplicated requests; replays amplify peak load, causing allocator exhaustion.
- H3: new memmap alignment changed page residency on some instance types, increasing GC pressure under high QPS.

kevin (eng-sre): rolling metric links and evidence attached: logs bundle: https://logs.internal/d/eagle-canary-2812349999.zip, probe samples: metrics://dash/rollouts/eagle/2812349999, heap snapshot link above.

lily (customer-success): posted interim message to customers: short note about mitigation (retry suppression) and we are testing a non-invasive runtime patch. Reference ticket CS-2026-044.

nora (oncall): patch started. monitoring windows: will watch error rate, dup_request, p95 latency. If stable in 20m, promote patch to stable and schedule a compatibility run for 24h before full rollout.

(12m later)

dan (eng-runtime): patch completed on canary set. early readouts: allocator spike events reduced by ~80% on patched pods, 5xx rate dropped to baseline for hosted canary. p95 latency back to expected.

monitor-bot: canary metrics snapshot at 10:40Z: 5xx baseline, dup_request under 2% across canary.

anya (ml): heap snapshots from patched pods show lower transient allocation peaks; fused-attn off appears to avoid the pathological allocation pattern. Will run synthetic long-context traffic test to validate.

kevin (eng-sre): Dedicated trial org 3344 still reports intermittent 5xxs (lower volume). I'm pulling their dedicated pod logs: `kubectl -n dedicated logs pod-ded-3344 --since=30m`. Link: https://logs.internal/d/ded-3344-2812349999.zip

lily (customer-success): informing org 3344 of current status and estimated next update in 30m.

nora (oncall): decision checkpoint: Hold promotion for 30m to monitor Dedicated impact. If org 3344 clears, proceed with promote; if not, consider pinning v5.0 for Dedicated only and continue investigating memmap alignment.

(20m later)

kevin (eng-sre): Dedicated org 3344 cleared after we adjusted cpuset on their hosts (hotfix applied by infra team). logs show no further allocator errors.

lily (customer-success): customers acknowledged the update and appreciate the proactive comms. CS will follow up with credit discussions where appropriate.

nora (oncall): marking incident mitigated for now. mitigation steps: retry suppression applied, sequential runtime patch to disable fused-attn, cpuset adjustment for Dedicated host, customer communications.

anya (ml): RCA hypotheses recorded in thread. Next steps for post-incident:
- Reproduce allocator spike in CI with long-context synthetic workload (anya)
- Add regression test for dup_request increase when router retries are non-zero (dan)
- Revert fused-attn default until validated across instance types (eng-ml + eng-runtime)
- Add canary-only memmap alignment check during model onboarding (platform)

kevin (eng-sre): follow ups: automate cpuset remediation runbook for Dedicated, add alert for dup_request >10% in future.

nora (oncall): I'll draft incident doc with timeline, diffs, logs, and decision points. saving evidence links: logs bundle, heap dumps, deploy job ids (jid-9921), cpuset fix ticket INFRA-334. Incident doc link: https://incidents.internal/2812349999.

lily (customer-success): leaving note: CS tickets: CS-2026-044, CS-2026-045.

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> mitigated (owner: nora). Paging closed at 11:15Z.

nora (oncall): thanks all. I'll hand off RCA draft to @anya for hypothesis validation and to @dan for regression tests if I'm off shift. tagging this thread in the model-rollout RCA evidence collection.
